This need is reflected on the latest Space Debris Mitigation requirements for lunar orbits, including disposal and availability of space traffic coordination methods. With various studies having explored disposed objects and debris clouds in cislunar space, the development of such models becomes increasingly feasible. Methods and software tools to perform assessments in Earth orbits exist and are well-used. To ensure safe operations and sustainability in cislunar space, an extended density-based model can be used for risk event statistics, delta-v planning for collision avoidance manoeuvres and reliability assessment due to impacts. The model shall leverage the results of recent studies on debris and clouds around the Moon and build upon the well-established tools andmethodologies for Earth orbits.
